spirit.label: Spirit
spirit.question: How is it with you and God?

ticks.label: Alive
ticks.helper: Connected to God. Receiving, not straining.

ticks.label: Managing
ticks.helper: Saying the right things, but running on my own strength.

ticks.label: Fading
ticks.helper: Far off. Love is hard to hear.

ticks.label: Rest
ticks.helper: Jaw soft. Free to be still or move.

ticks.label: Control
ticks.helper: Gripping, scanning, trying to stay on top of it.

ticks.label: Fight
ticks.helper: Heated. Pushing back. Need to win.

ticks.label: Flight
ticks.helper: Wanting out — a screen, a door, a task.

ticks.label: Open
ticks.helper: Here, and open to what comes.

ticks.label: Narrowed
ticks.helper: Here, but locked on judging, fixing, or solving.

ticks.label: Past or future
ticks.helper: Replaying what happened or dreading what’s next.

dyingPins.label: I have to get this right to be loved.
This feels like too much to stay in.
This is more than I have.
Nothing feels steady enough to trust.
I’m on my own in this.
It’s all on me to make this right.

managedPins.label: God helps those who help themselves.
I’ll turn to God after I finish this.
I don’t need anything right now.

strategiesByBody.control: Put down what you’re gripping for ten minutes. Notice if your hand keeps reaching for it.
strategiesByBody.fight: Before you make your case, say one sentence: “This feels like an attack. Give me a minute.”
strategiesByBody.flight: Stay where you are for five minutes. The screen can wait.
strategiesByBody.freeze: Feel the chair under you. Loosen your jaw. Don’t try to solve anything yet.
strategiesByBody.collapse: Name one thing you can feel in your body, or just say “I’m checked out.” Don’t try to explain it.
strategiesByBody.rest: Stay as you are. Your body doesn’t need fixing.

strategiesByMind.present_open: Stay as you are. Nothing to fix.
strategiesByMind.present_narrowed: For one minute, stop judging or fixing. Look at the person in front of you as they are today.
strategiesByMind.time_travel: Come back to this room. If you’re in the future: sort what you can do from what you can’t, and pick one thing to do in the next day. If you’re in the past: name the old memory that’s replaying.
strategiesByMind.blank: Don’t try to figure it out. Start with your body. After two breaths, say one word: “here.”

strategiesByPin.unloved: Look at the person as they are today. Tell yourself: “This may be an old hurt talking.”
strategiesByPin.unworthy: Don’t try to prove yourself. Stay here as you are.
strategiesByPin.unsafe: Stay for one minute. Don’t try to fix it. Feel the chair under you.
strategiesByPin.not_enough: Sort what you can do from what you can’t. Pick one thing to do in the next day. Feeling overwhelmed doesn’t mean you’ve failed.
strategiesByPin.no_trust: Tell God one honest sentence. Don’t add a “but.” Then wait.
strategiesByPin.alone: Tell God one honest sentence. Don’t add a “but.” Then wait.
strategiesByPin.must_carry: Name what hurts. Let other people carry their own feelings.
strategiesByPin.unknown_dying: Sit for a moment. Don’t try to fix anything. Let one true sentence come.
strategiesByPin.in_control: Put down what you’re gripping for ten minutes. Notice your hand reaching for it.
strategiesByPin.earned_place: Notice one good thing you didn’t earn or provide for yourself, and receive it.
strategiesByPin.better_than: Finish the sentence: better than whom? Then, for one minute, stop comparing.
strategiesByPin.mine_to_manage: Name what isn’t yours to carry today. Say it out loud.
strategiesByPin.up_to_me: Pick one thing that really is yours to do. Leaving the rest undone isn’t a failure.
strategiesByPin.proverb: Do the one small thing that’s yours to do. Stop before it feels finished, and leave the rest with God.
strategiesByPin.abide_after: After you pray, sit quietly with God for one minute before moving on.
strategiesByPin.need_nothing: Name one thing you actually need right now, in a few words.
strategiesByPin.unknown_managed: Put down what you’re holding and sit for one minute.

onboarding.title: I Am Here
onboarding.body: Home is abiding in Christ: spirit alive to God, body in restful flow, mind present and open. It is received, not earned. This app helps you notice when you have left, and take one step back.

onboarding.title: How it works
onboarding.body: Tap how your spirit, body, and mind are right now. If a thought is weighing on you, pick the sentence closest to it. Then breathe for a minute with a line of Scripture. No scores. No streaks.

crisis.line: If you are in danger, call or text 988 in the US.

pin.titleDying: Which sentence feels true right now?
pin.titleManaged: Which sentence is in charge right now?
pin.followup: Take a second look. Which of these would you least want to be true?

strategy.honestyProverb: That saying isn’t in the Bible. It’s self-reliance talking.

home.line: Home is abiding in Christ: spirit alive to God, body in restful flow, mind present and open.
home.text: You’re home. Stay here a moment.

settings.title: Settings
settings.about: I Am Here helps you notice where you are — spirit, body, and mind — and take one step back toward home. Home is abiding in Christ: spirit alive to God, body in restful flow, mind present and open.
